run_rloo_training: run the RLOO training script with a model, reward functions, and dataset for reinforcement learning
configure_rloo_reward_funcs: configure reward functions including accuracy, reasoning accuracy, think format, and overlong punishment rewards
build_rloo_trainer: build an RLOO trainer with a pretrained model, reward funcs, train/eval datasets, and PEFT config
parse_rloo_cli_args: parse command-line arguments for the RLOO training script using TrlParser with dataclass configs
load_rloo_dataset: load a dataset for RLOO training from Hugging Face Hub or local datasets with train/test splits
